subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of their experience are Yelp reviewers talking about?

judge.implied_focus: The experiential aspects/dimensions of a dining experience that Yelp reviewers mention (food, service, ambiance, price, cleanliness, wait time)

per_column.name: mentions_food_quality
per_column.rationale: A concrete experiential aspect of the dining experience -- directly a facet of the inferred focus.

per_column.name: mentions_service
per_column.rationale: Service is a core aspect of the reviewer experience; coherent facet.

per_column.name: mentions_ambiance
per_column.rationale: Ambiance is a recognized experience dimension; on-focus.

per_column.name: mentions_price
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a standard aspect reviewers discuss; on-focus.

per_column.name: mentions_cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Cleanliness is a distinct experiential facet; on-focus.

per_column.name: mentions_wait_time
per_column.rationale: Wait time is a specific experience aspect; on-focus.

per_column.name: num_aspects_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Aggregates breadth of aspects covered per review; a coherent summary variable over the aspect set.

per_column.name: review_length
per_column.rationale: Bare text length is a generic mechanical metric that does not encode any experiential aspect; off-focus filler.

judge.rationale: The columns overwhelmingly centre on one clear, data-inferable focus: the aspects of the dining experience reviewers discuss. Six binary mention flags form a well-differentiated facet set at a useful granularity, and num_aspects_mentioned provides a coherent breadth summary derived from them -- a sound analytical structure directly answering the query. This is genuine aspect decomposition, not a restatement or noise, and an analyst can act on it (e.g., prioritize which aspects drive positive/negative sentiment). The lone weakness is review_length, a generic mechanical metric that does not realise the focus, but it is a single peripheral column and does not undermine the otherwise strong, coherent structure.
